result.note: Tests the July 2026 first private Indian orbital launch by Skyroot's Vikram 1 and India's global position in private orbital launches.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Vikram 1 rocket, which reached orbit on 21 July 2026:
items: It is India's first privately developed orbital rocket.
Its success made India the third country, after the US and China, where a private firm has reached orbit.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements are correct. Skyroot's Vikram 1 reached orbit on Tuesday, 21 July 2026, as India's first privately developed orbital rocket. This placed India alongside the US and China as the only countries where a private firm has reached orbit.
questions.source: Skyroot's Vikram 1 reached orbit, India's first privately developed orbital rocket, making it the third country after the US and China where a private firm has done so.
